segments.text: Aya is Kanata, Touka and Kazane's childhood friend. In their childhood, she and Kanata's family were neighbours and so she spent a lot of time playing with Kanata, for whom she began to develop different feelings but whose scope she did not yet understand.

When Kanata returns to the city, she is naturally excited and eager to see him again and reintroduce him to the daily life of the city, such as introducing him to his new classmates and their head teacher, who is none other than Sakura, while sharing as much time as possible with him since they can now live under the same roof as him and repeating their little rituals they had in childhood like waking him up in the morning, taking a nap with him, watching horror movies with him and many other things.
However, she didn't expect her to have to fight with the other girls to be able to spend time with him, especially with Rina who monopolizes him to play video games...
主人公の幼馴染。昔は同じアパートの隣人同士。
親同士が学生からの付き合いでその流れで2人は赤ちゃんの頃から一緒。
お互いの家に、預けたり、預けられたりもした。
昔は、人見知りで、怖がり。
注目されるのも苦手だったが主人公と一緒にいる内に、心を開き、明るくなっていった。
注目される事を気にしなくなると、スポーツの才能も開花させた。
『主人公を誰よりも信頼している類の主人公好き』
お昼寝やお風呂を主人公（幼少期）と一緒にしたこともある。
彼女の中ではそれが当たり前になってしまっていて、“昔は“気になっていなかった。
【性格・特徴】
活発で天衣無縫、自由な性格。好奇心旺盛。
あらゆる事に偏見がなく、誰とでもすぐ仲良くなってしまう。
主人公が自分以外と楽しそうにしていると、妬いてしまう。

Kazane is Rina's cousin, Touka's childhood friend and cousin and the childhood friend of Aya and Kanata. Very close to Kanata when they were very young many found them inseparable and jokingly said that they made a pretty little couple. With a strong sense of responsibility, she is very active in the life of the school.

When Kanata returned to town, Kazane didn't recognize him when Kanata recognized her at first sight. For unknown reasons, Kazane does not welcome Kanata very friendly, but rather neutral, which Kanata does not really understand because they were rather close as children.
Being cold with him, Kazane is logically not really the most friendly towards Kanata of all the girls in the house. However, Kazane realizes that she may not be the only girl who has eyes on him...
主人公の義祖父の親類の孫娘。
主人公や彩とは幼稚園からの付き合い。
故に幼馴染でもあるが、腐れ縁だと思っている。
子どもの時からまじめであまり感情を表に出さない。
勤勉で努力家、鼻にかけない、いわゆるクールな秀才だが。
実は、なんでも卒なくこなす主人公をライバル視している。
『前を歩く背中が気になっていた類の主人公好き』
スポーツ、勉強、何をするにも主人公に勝った事がなく、そうこうしている内に主人公が海外に行ってしまった。
自分の前を行っていた主人公がいなくなってもスッキリとせず、寂しさを感じていた。
【性格・特徴】
真面目で素直じゃない性格。一度言ったら決して曲げない頑固者な面もある。
裏を返せば一途。関係構築が不器用。
負けず嫌い。主人公ができる事は自分もできないと気が済まない。

Touka is Kanata's older sister and the childhood friend of Aya, Kazane's childhood friend and cousin and is Rina's cousin. Although Kanata and her aren't bound by blood, she has always taken her role as an older sister very seriously, protecting and incubating him with love since the beginning. A model student, she is an example to all the students in the school and attracts the attention of all boys and girls, respecting and admiring her to the highest degree and making the school and hers family proud.

When she learned from her stepfather that Kanata was returning to town and that he was going to be transferred to her school, she offered to meet him at the station and introduce him to the other girls in the dormitory. Kanata is very surprised when he saw her because, although she has always been very pretty, Touka has grown up very well and is even more charming than before. Having been separated for a number of years, Kanata fears that it is difficult for them to speak as they did before, but in vain because Touka speaks to him as if they had never been separated.

However even though Kanata has grown up Touka is still as caring as ever with him, even though his needs have changed. No longer in need of protection, she then takes it upon herself to make him understand that she can satisfy his "love" needs...
主人公の義父の娘。主人公の義姉。スーパー姉。
彩や楓音とも長い付き合い。本物の天才。
完璧超人。花顔雪膚。いつも憧れの的。
口数は少なく、必要最低限の会話しかしない。
なんだか近寄りがたく、まるでお嬢様のような雰囲気を醸し出していて、ミステリアス。
気を抜いた教職員が彼女に心奪われる事もしばしば。
『主人公にだけ心を許している類の主人公好き』
主人公のなんでも受け入れてくれる器のデカさに胸を撃ち抜かれ、ずっと主人公についていくと心に決めた。普通に会話もする。姉としてできる限りの事をしつづけている…が。
本人は結構最初から主人公を異性として見ている。
【性格・特徴】
達観しており、必要な場合を除いて、主人公以外とはあまりしゃべらない。
主人公が「よろしく」と言ったから、彩や楓音と仲良くしていたにすぎないフシがあったりもする。
主人公以外の事はあまり興味がない。

Rina is the youngest resident of the house and is half Japanese, giving her an exotic look, which is quite charming. She is one of the granddaughters of Touka and Kazane's grandfather and is therefore one of their cousins. Sweet, popular, open to all topics of discussion and easily affordable, Rina has many friends at school and gets along beautifully with the other residents even with Sakura-sensei, however none of her acquaintances are passionate about video games and so she often finds herself playing alone in her room on days when she doesn't go out with her friends.

When Kanata arrives in the house, she is quite happy to meet him because she has heard a lot about him (in a positive way) from Touka, Aya and Kazane and was therefore quite eager to meet him. To tease him a little, she decided to call him "Onii-chan" because he seems embarrassed when she calls him that and she likes to see him that way.

She quickly introduced Kanata to her sanctuary (room) dedicated to video games after a horrible insect that was walking around her room came out. They sometimes spend whole days playing together, attracting on Rina the jealousy from the other girls...
皆が暮らす家の大家（主人公の義祖父）の孫娘。
実は、楓音や冬華とは遠めな親戚同士。
父が日本人、母が北欧系のハーフ。国籍は日本。
日本生まれ日本育ちなので、日本語に不自由はない。
コミュ力が高く、可愛いためどこでも目立ってしまう人気者。マスコット的な存在。
丁寧で気さくなのだが、実は自分が楽しむのを優先していたりする。
ちょっとしたイタズラ好き。
『おふざけからマジになっていく系の主人公好き』
表では優秀な生徒としてふるまっているが、かなりのゲーマー。
主人公が一緒に遊んでくれるのでちょっと甘えてみたら、可愛い反応をするので面白くて遊んでいたら自分の方が…。
【性格・特徴】
あらゆる意味で賢い。裏表をしっかりと使いこなす様はまるでベテラン芸能人。
人に嫌な思いをさせることなく、のせて転がすのが得意。
思い通りにならないと、ちょっとムキになっちゃう。

Sakura is a young woman who recently started teaching and is also in charge of managing the dormitory. She is a long-standing acquaintance of the grandfather because she was one of his student when she was a university student and that he was still working in his profession. Beautiful, delicate, charming, she is very popular with the students and with the other teachers. She takes her role as an educator very seriously and seeks to help all her students.

When Kanata arrives in the dormitory, she puts him at ease right away, reassuring him about the very large female presence in the house and making him understand that if he needs to confide in her or to talk about his problems, that she would be listening and always ready to help him.
However, even if Kanata finds that she has a lot of charisma, Sakura is not really used to boys and she doesn't really know how to advise them but she still does her best.
主人公の事は話で聞いていたので知っていたが、面識はなかった。
義祖父が大学で教授をしていた時の教え子。
学園のOBでもある。現在は数学教師。
ひとたび歩けば、あっという間に視線をくぎ付けにしてしまう大人の魅力をもち、授業をする姿も凛として美しく、かなり人気がある。
実は有望視されていた歌で勝負する系のアイドルだったが、所属事務所のやり方に噛みついた結果、業界から干されてしまった過去をもつ。
『聞き上手な主人公に心を解された系の主人公好き』
生徒思いでありつつも、意外とサバサバしている、あまり執着しない、肝の据わった強い女性だが、甘えられる対象がいると弱いと気付く。
【性格・特徴】
現実の酸いも甘いも知っていて、大人の意見、見解を教え子達に押し付けることなく教えていく良い教師。魚を与えるのではなく捕り方を教える的な。
気を許した相手にはとことん弱くなってしまう。

Kanata is the younger stepbrother of Touka and the childhood friend of Kazane and Aya.

After living 10 years away from his hometown in a foreign country, Kanata returned to settle there to continue his studies. He was surprised to see his older sister and his other childhood friends again to see that they had all grown up and changed a lot.

Upon his arrival, Kanata realizes that he will not only live with his sister Touka in a house, but with many attractive young women including Touka, Aya and Kazane in addition to the cute landlord named Rina and the mature and attractive Sakura-sensei.

Needless to say, it then becomes difficult for our hero not to look at them with a lewd look when these young ladies have still not lost their habit of living only between girls, leading him into the most exciting situations.
A tumultuous life is looming for our hero...
